purpose: Re-evaluate current packed PARO MTP fast and strict verifier routes after the grouped PARO GDN head-layout repair, and separate verifier arithmetic from shared proposer defects.

full_vocab_f16_screen.scope: fast route, raw D24, three diagnostic prompts

general_ja_plan.decision: acceptance and economics positive despite the F16 full-head cost

full_vocab_f16_screen.interpretation: The cap is a real multilingual defect, but a universal full-vocabulary F16 head is still too expensive. The target already owns a full-vocabulary W8A16 head; sharing its fused scorer is the next candidate.

fast.decision: stopped after the first binding heldout failure; the D24 exact-ID gate ends immediately before this visible divergence

proposer_findings: The persistent PARO proposer captures pre-final-norm last-layer BF16 target taps. nano-vLLM-amd@5d8f496da5e3 and upstream vLLM@470229c37efa feed Qwen3.5 MTP final output-normalized target hidden states.

After target verify/commit, PARO calls advance_with_previous_hidden and never consumes the selected target hidden/final row required by docs/MTP.md. The proposer is seeded from target hidden only during prompt prefill.

The proposer scores capped F16 lm_head rows, while target AR/verifier uses a full-vocabulary W8A16 head. This changes the draft decision surface, guarantees multilingual cap rejects, and duplicates roughly 1.017 GB of F16 head storage instead of sharing the target scorer.
verifier_findings: Current grouped-head fast and strict D24 routes have identical target IDs and acceptance, so the old 7.48% strict acceptance artifact is stale rather than evidence that strict arithmetic destroys acceptance.
Strict c1 is a sound state/token oracle but is about 1.35 ms/cycle slower at D24.

Fast decode_batched is deterministic enough to stay token-equal through D24 and one D64 code prompt, but state differs immediately and one D64 heldout becomes token-visible at index 24. It requires a production-profile teacher-forced numerical/task gate; it is not a strict route.

keep: fast decode_batched verifier as an explicit production-profile candidate only
repair_order: Fix PARO target-hidden lifecycle: final output-normalized prompt taps and selected target hidden reseed after every verify/commit.
Replace capped private F16 proposal scoring with the target's resident full-vocabulary W8A16 fused top-1 scorer; gate full category+heldout economics and target-token rank.
Add a registered PARO strict/production variant manifest instead of manual partial env combinations.
Build the PARO strict-teacher production numerical/task gate. Promote fast only if all calibrated thresholds, determinism, ownership, and task checks pass.
Only if the corrected target-hidden and matched-head proposer remains economics-negative should the project replace the stitched sidecar with an integrated target+NextN artifact.
